name: sending-platforms
description: Compares, selects, and configures cold email sending platforms: Smartlead, Instantly, Salesforge, Apollo, and others. Use when the user asks which sending platform to use, needs to compare features or pricing, wants to migrate between platforms, or needs platform-specific setup guidance. Activates on phrases like "which email platform," "Smartlead vs Instantly," "best sending tool," "Salesforge setup," "Apollo sequences," or "migrate sending platform."
